layers.name: White-haired mechanical woman Vivhite
layers.description: Extract the complete white-haired mechanical woman Vivhite as one single foreground layer, keep her thin round gold glasses, individual silver-lavender hair strands, black-and-gold wing ornaments, hand, shoulders and all visible ivory armor intact. Trace the outer silhouette closely, especially the fine hair around both sides of the head and over the shoulders. Do NOT include any purple-black gradient, backlight aura, soft gray fringe, diffuse glow cloud or background content. Preserve all actual sharp hair strands from the input, no redrawing or blurring. The alpha immediately beyond each physical strand and armor edge must be zero, no wide feathered transition or colored matte.
